Row.Text: A pair of carved pillars wander the sea. Once they stood at the high seat, treasures of a chief who rejected the crown and departed his crowded fjord to sail his household towards rumors and hope. Now, guided by the gods, the pillars lead their owner to a new shore.
Through strength and stubbornness, these Icelanders will realize their full potential.
The story of his departure is the greater gift.

For young Icelandic sailors, the days of viking raids belong not to their grandfathers, but to some distant “Iceland” long in the past. A new military ad campaign, though, seeks to make these relevant again: “Write your own saga”, the poster proclaims in runes, and features an image of a bearded warrior leaping to the shore, assault rifle in hand.
Keep the sagas as poems of a gone but remembered age.
Valhalla is timeless, and the valkyries still fly.
